note: #1061: tclean's primary-beam masks and normalization against CASA 6.7.6.14 with tools/casa-compat/tclean_case_matrix.py. The pbsquare cases image ALMA's three-field refim_alma_mosaic.ms (340 GHz, noise-free) over an image larger than its beam, so the pbsquare residual, which has no cutoff, reaches past pblimit; test_widefield_mosaicft_mtmfs_pbsquare.1 in tclean-casa-test-cases.json is the Taylor case. The pbmask cases image the VLA's refim_point.ms (1 to 1.95 GHz, 25 m dishes) over 1.7 degrees, past the L-band beam's 0.2 circle, and the same ALMA mosaic: usemask='pb' (SDMaskHandler::makePBMask), a named mask under pbmask, auto-multithresh under pbmask (autoMaskWithinPB) and the nsigma noise at pbmask (calcRobustRMS). Under auto-multithresh pblimit is 0.1, so that a pbmask of 0.2 is not the residual's own pixel mask.

alma_mosaic_pbsquare.note: pbsquare on a single-term mosaic: the residual divided by the PB peak squared, the model through PB squared

alma_mosaic_pbsquare_cube.note: pbsquare per channel of a three-channel mosaic cube, each channel by its own weight image

alma_mosaic_pbsquare_pbcor.note: pbsquare with pbcor: the restored image divided by the PB

alma_mosaic_pbsquare_negative_pblimit.note: pbsquare under a negative pblimit: CASA drops the residual's and the image's pixel masks, so the pbsquare residual past the PB, which no cutoff zeroes, is compared too

point_standard_usemask_pb.note: usemask='pb' on a standard-gridder VLA image: the clean mask is the analytic .pb above pbmask (makePBMask)

alma_mosaic_usemask_pb.note: usemask='pb' on a three-field mosaic: the clean mask is the weight image's .pb above pbmask

point_cube_usemask_pb.note: usemask='pb' on a 20-channel cube: each channel's mask is its own .pb above pbmask, the beam narrowing with frequency

point_standard_box_pbmask.note: a named box under pbmask, crossing the .pb's 0.5 circle: the box kept where the .pb exceeds pbmask (makePBMask(combinemask=True))

point_automask_pbmask.note: auto-multithresh under pbmask 0.2 and pblimit 0.1: the automatic mask's statistics, pruning and support above pbmask, and the mask cut to it (autoMaskWithinPB)

alma_mosaic_automask_pbmask.note: auto-multithresh on the mosaic under pbmask 0.2 and pblimit 0.1; the data are noise-free, so a sidelobethreshold of 0.1 lets the noise threshold set the mask

point_standard_nsigma_pbmask.note: nsigma under pbmask 0.5: calcRobustRMS's noise of the pixels whose .pb exceeds pbmask, with no clean mask; the run stops on nsigma

point_automask_nsigma_pbmask.note: auto-multithresh with nsigma under pbmask 0.5: at the first boundary the mask takes calcRobustRMS's statistics at pbmask, later its own
